pages.title: Fuel Silo
pages.text: Turns caldera sulfur and frozen atmosphere into $(bold)Rocket Fuel Cells$(). The rocket needs 6.
Mars sent a launch package, not a rocket.$(br2)$(flavor)ORSA calls this field expedient launch readiness.$()

pages.title: Shell
pages.text: $(li)3x3 iron shell, 4 tall$(li)Solid iron floor$(li)Hollow center above the floor$(li)Controller in the middle of one outside face$(li)Any $(l:heating/thermal_heater)Thermal Heater$(/l) attached outside

pages.name: Fuel Silo
pages.text: Higher heater tiers run faster; capacitors faster still.

pages.title: Controller
pages.text: Craft the controller first; it holds the interface.$(br2)$(flavor)The shell is plain iron blocks. Of course it is.$()

pages.title: Feedstock
pages.text: $(bold)Sulfur:$() mine sulfur ore in mature rupture calderas; smelt the Impure Sulfur it drops.$(br2)$(bold)Atmosphere Shards:$() Phase 6, carried in a $(l:heating/thermal_container)Thermal Container$(/l).
$(bold)Backup:$() the silo turns a sulfur lava bucket into impure sulfur.

pages.title: Processing
pages.text: Each makes one, base time:$(li)$(bold)Propellant:$() 4 Sulfur, 2 Coal, 60 s$(li)$(bold)Oxidizer:$() 4 Atmosphere Shards, 90 s$(li)$(bold)Reduction:$() 1 Sulfur Lava Bucket to 2 Impure Sulfur, 90 s
$(bold)Fuel Cell:$() 2 Propellant, 2 Oxidizer, 1 Acheronite Shard, 120 s.

pages.title: Fueling
pages.text: Carry the 6 cells to the blast pit and right-click the assembled rocket to load them by hand.$(br2)$(danger)The silo is the slow part.$() Budget time, heater fuel and a second sulfur run.
